accessibility.description: Built-in screen reader play turns on automatically with VoiceOver or TalkBack. Aim by named directions, fire with a double tap and hear each volley's results. A board scan, optional aim sounds and a practice tutorial support nonvisual play. AppleVis reports full VoiceOver accessibility on iOS. The developer reports labelled Workshop and Shop screens with spoken purchase confirmations. Android TalkBack support is developer-reported and has had less testing; independent blind-player verification of the Android build is not established.
